name: Grand National Assembly
role: Passes the laws everything else rests on.
legal_basis: Laws 4628, 5346, 5710, 6446 and the laws that amend them

name: Presidency
role: Sets support prices after 2020 and may raise the unlicensed generation limit by decision.
legal_basis: Law 5346 Art. 6; Law 6446 Art. 14 (as amended by Decree Law 703)

name: Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources
role: Ranks and opens renewable resource areas (YEKA) and runs the competitions; sets nuclear energy sales procedures; sets details of facility inspection.

name: Energy Market Regulatory Authority
role: Licenses market activities; issues the market regulations (licence, balancing and settlement, ancillary services, capacity mechanism, unlicensed generation, storage, charging, aggregation, tariffs); sets tariffs, the free consumer limit and the price limits; approves the capacity mechanism budget; decides the YEKDEM cost projection.

name: Turkish Electricity Transmission Company
role: Operates the transmission system and the balancing power market; procures ancillary services; proposes the capacity mechanism budget; gives grid connection opinions; ENTSO-E observer member; allocates interconnection capacity.
legal_basis: Law 6446; Ancillary Services and Capacity Mechanism Regulations; TEİAŞ page for ENTSO-E

name: Energy Markets Operator
role: Runs the day-ahead market, intraday market, forward market and imbalance settlement; issues YEK-G certificates; announces the total renewable support charge; operates the Transparency Platform; named operator of the emissions trading market.
legal_basis: Law 6446 Art. 11; EPİAŞ regulation 2015; YEK-G Regulation; Law 7552

name: Electricity Generation Company (state)
role: State generation; mobile plants may take part in the capacity mechanism; export limit rule for generation licensees refers to it.
legal_basis: Law 4628 (split of TEAŞ); import export regulation

name: Distribution companies
role: Run distribution grids; connect and settle unlicensed plants in their region; investment refunds for connections; privatised 2008 to 2013.

name: Privatisation Administration
role: Sold the distribution companies (the page read does not name the body).

name: Central settlement institution
role: Holds collateral and carries out advance, invoice and assignment payments of market participants.

name: Climate Change Presidency
role: Establishes the emissions trading system, allocates allowances, oversees monitoring and verification.

name: Petroleum Pipeline Corporation (gas)
role: Wholesale gas prices; the 2026 retail gas tariffs followed its wholesale prices.
